title: A Prom for the Locker
author: Astrid Vasquez
blurb: August Thornbury, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
